hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext:
This repo keeps context docs in docs/context/. Read the docs relevant to your task before starting, and check docs/context/errors.md before proposing a fix, searching it for the failure's Signature. An entry whose Status is not fixed, or that lists 'Tried and failed' attempts, means rethink the theory before another attempt. Index:

- [auth.md](auth.md) : read when changing auth

Context docs: if the repo you work in has docs/context/INDEX.md, read it and the docs it marks relevant first. Before handing back, update those docs for what you changed. End your report with a line 'Context docs: updated <files>' or 'Context docs: no change needed, <reason>' or 'Context docs: none in this repo'.

Acceptance: before handing back, check every acceptance criterion from your brief against what you actually did, run the checks, and fix what fails. Include a section headed 'Acceptance check' with one line per criterion: '<criterion> : met | not met : <evidence>'. Evidence is required on every line: what you ran or inspected and the result, for example '- tests pass : met : npm run test:unit -- foo, 14 passed'. A bare met, done, yes or checkmark is sent back. If a criterion is not met or could not be verified, say so and give the reason; a not verified line with no reason is sent back too.
